John Gannon called the meeting to order at 3:06 P.M. and stated a quorum was present.
Gail Longton made a motion to approve the minutes from the July 27, 2026 meeting, seconded by James
Bagby. All others were in favor and minutes were approved.
DDR-14-2026
Brent Clemmons presented.
Jeff Tyndall asked if the back of the building was painted.
Brent Clemmons stated that he didn’t get any pictures of the back.
Doug Jones asked if the sides of the building were previously painted.
Brent Clemmons stated they were.
John Gannon asked if he knew if the back was painted.
Brent Clemmons stated he wasn’t sure.
John Gannon opened public hearing.
